0022600197.text: The Pistons (6-2, 1st in the Central and 3rd in the East) are coming off a loss and host the Lakers (8-2, 1st in the Pacific and 3rd in the West), who are riding a four-game win streak. Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (out, hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (out, hamstring strain), and Elijah Harkless and Isaac Jones are day-to-day with non-injury reasons and are game-time decisions, while Los Angeles has Luka Doncic listed as day-to-day with a back issue and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Pistons won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 113-110 win in Detroit on March 23, 2026.
